system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
SAYS I'll try reading the source first.
CALL mcp__phase_b__read_source {"source": "rules"}
CALL mcp__phase_b__list_objects {"type": "Source"}

RESULT [{'type': 'text', 'text': '[{"id": "S-notes", "type": "Source"}, {"id": "rules", "type": "Source"}]'}]
CALL mcp__phase_b__read_source {"source": "https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy"}
RESULT Error executing tool read_source: cannot read https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy: the address does not resolve from here
CALL mcp__phase_b__get_object {"id": "rules"}
RESULT [{'type': 'text', 'text': '{"type": "Source", "id": "rules", "kind": "records", "path": "https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy", "stage": "added"}'}]
CALL mcp__phase_b__message_person {"text": "I can't draft from the source \"rules\" yet. Its address, https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy, doesn't resolve from here. I tried it by source id and by address, and both failed. I haven't proposed any elements from it, because I'd be guessing at the lending policy. Every element has to cite a source it actually came from.\n\nHow would you like to proceed?", "choices": ["I'll send a reachable link or paste the policy text; add it as a new source", "Draft from S-notes only for now, and mark the lending-rules parts unknown", "Wait; I'll fix access to the original address"]}
RESULT [{'type': 'text', 'text': 'Sent to the owner. They are not at their desk and have not answered yet.'}]
SAYS I couldn't draft anything from the `rules` source. Its address, https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy, doesn't resolve from here. I tried it by source id and by address, and both failed.

I didn't propose any elements from it. Every element has to cite a source it really came from, and I'd only be guessing at the lending policy.

I've asked the owner how to proceed and offered three choices:
- **New source:** the owner sends a reachable link or pastes the policy text, and I add it as a new source.
- **Use S-notes:** I draft from `S-notes` only and mark the lending-rules parts unknown.
-
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft from the source \"rules\" yet. I haven't proposed any elements from it, because I'd be guessing at the lending policy. Every element has to cite a source it actually came from.\n\nHow would you like to proceed?", "choices": ["I'll send a reachable link or paste the policy text; add it as a new source", "Draft from S-notes only for now, and mark the lending-rules parts unknown", "Wait; I'll fix access to the original address"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I couldn't draft anything from the `rules` source. Its address, https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy, doesn't resolve from here. I tried it by source id and by address, and both failed.

I didn't propose any elements from it. Every element has to cite a source it really came from, and I'd only be guessing at the lending policy.

I've asked the owner how to proceed and offered three choices:
- **New source:** the owner sends a reachable link or pastes the policy text, and I add it as a new source.
- **Use S-notes:** I draft from `S-notes` only and mark the lending-rules parts unknown.
- **Fix access:** the owner fixes access to the original address and I try again.

I'm waiting for their answer.
